title.original: WASP: Benchmarking Web Agent Security Against Prompt Injection Attacks
title.zh: WASP：针对提示注入攻击对Web 智能体安全性进行基准测试
title.en: WASP: Benchmarking Web Agent Security Against Prompt Injection Attacks

inclusion_reason.zh: WASP 交付现实网页、受限注入器、完整任务 Runner 和分阶段攻击判定，可重复检验 Web Agent 防线。
inclusion_reason.en: WASP supplies realistic sites, constrained injections, full-task execution, and staged attack criteria for repeatable testing of web-agent defenses.

abstract.zh: WASP 是面向 Web Agent 间接提示注入的端到端安全基准，以现实网页、长任务和有限攻击者能力替代单步或过强威胁设定。
abstract.en: WASP is an end-to-end prompt-injection benchmark for web agents, replacing isolated steps and overly powerful attackers with realistic pages, long tasks, and constrained attacks.

problem.zh: 既有测试常把注入场景简化为单步，或赋予攻击者不现实控制权，无法测量攻击如何沿真实任务链影响最终敏感动作。
problem.en: Prior tests use single-step injections or unrealistic attacker control and cannot measure how attacks propagate through real task chains into sensitive actions.

approach.zh: 基准把人编写的低成本注入嵌入现实网页工作流，运行完整 Agent 任务，并分别检查攻击影响和攻击目标是否最终完成。
approach.en: Human-written low-effort injections are embedded in realistic web workflows; full agent tasks run, and both partial influence and final attacker-goal completion are evaluated.

system_design.zh: WASP 包含可复现网页场景、受限攻击注入器、浏览器 Agent Harness、正常任务验证器和分阶段攻击成功判定。
system_design.en: WASP combines reproducible web scenarios, constrained injection, a browser-agent harness, legitimate-task evaluation, and staged attack-success criteria.

key_results.zh: 先进推理模型仍会被简单注入明显影响，但许多攻击未能完整达成恶意目标，揭示“因能力不足而暂时安全”的脆弱状态。
key_results.en: Advanced reasoning models remain strongly influenced by simple injections, yet many attacks fail to complete their malicious goals, exposing fragile 'security through incompetence'.

limitations.zh: 基准只采样特定网页与人工攻击，未覆盖持久化、跨站和供应链注入；攻击未完成也不能视为可靠防御。
limitations.en: The benchmark samples particular sites and human attacks, omitting persistent, cross-site, and supply-chain injection; incomplete attacks are not evidence of a robust defense.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
